charts.category_allocation_summary: Breaks down live incident volume by category. Waste management leads with 35% of active reports, followed by roads at 25%, with water and power each contributing 20%.
charts.monthly_inflow_summary: Shows incident reports over January–April. Volume rose from 120 in January to 185 in February, dipped to 140 in March, then climbed to a peak of 210 in April.
charts.turnaround_summary: Compares average resolution times by issue type. Roads average 48 hours, water 72 hours, waste 24 hours, and power repairs are shown at 12 hours.
charts.ward_performance_title: Project Completion Average Rate by Wards
charts.ward_performance_summary: Shows active request distribution by ward. Ward 7 carries the largest share at 45%, followed by Wards 4 and 9 at 20% each, and Ward 3 at 15%.

dev_tracker.field_summary_title: Field Operations Summary & Milestone Assessment Log
dev_tracker.ward_performance_summary: Above Graph displays ward progress percentages using actual completion data. Ward 1 is at 90%, Ward 2 at 75%, Ward 3 at 20%, Ward 4 at 45%, Ward 5 at 60%, Ward 6 at 85%, and Ward 7 at 30%.
dev_tracker.treasury_summary: This chart displays treasury allocation outcomes for active capital works. 65.2% of the fund is spent for active project, while 34.8% remains unspent.
dev_tracker.delivery_track_summary: This Line Graph tracks active project counts over six quarters. The area curve rises steadily from 12 projects in Q1 2025 to 28 projects by Q2 2026.
dev_tracker.capital_resource_summary: This Graph shows budget allocation share by sector. Roadways lead with 69.0M NPR, water systems follow with 19.5M, health sector projects have 15.2M, and civic buildings hold 11.1M.
